articles.summary: Seaboard Marine recently completed a significant diesel emission reduction project, which included replacing six (6) yard tractors and one (1) 30-ton cargo handling forklift. This initiative was supported by the United States DERA 2023 grant awarded by the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA).The project was facilitated by Leonardo Academy, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing
articles.title: Seaboard Marine Completes Diesel Emissions Reduction Projects Supported by DERA Grant
